subject: Request: latest penetration test & secure transfer options for Hosted API
messages:
From: Cindy Lowe <cindy.lowe@acmetech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmetech.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure handoff

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing our SIG and CAIQ work for an upcoming board review and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API surface. Can you confirm: 1) whether the report includes external blackbox testing vs. internal infrastructure, 2) what the allowable distribution/redaction rules are, and 3) recommended secure transfer options?

Acme’s security team prefers encrypted vault delivery or DocuSign-style sealed envelopes; if there are constraints on sharing full appendices (IP/third-party findings), an executive summary would be acceptable for now. We can sign an NDA if needed.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@acmetech.com) in case there are contract or PO steps.

Thanks — Cindy
Cindy Lowe
Head of Security, Acme Tech
Attachment: requested-metadata.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Cindy Lowe <cindy.lowe@acmetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test for Hosted API and secure handoff

Thanks for the note, Cindy — appreciate the details. Short answer: we can share an encrypted executive summary immediately and provide the full report under a controlled access flow after an NDA and a short scope confirmation. Below are the transfer options we support and a redaction checklist to help you decide what you need:

Options (ordered by security + auditability):
- Tokenized secure vault link (preferred): provides single-use, time-limited access with MFA and audit trail. We can set IP restrictions and require an Acme SSO assertion.
- Encrypted artifact (GPG) via our evidence portal: we upload a GPG-encrypted file and provide a key exchange using an ephemeral link.
- Presigned S3 download: limited lifetime, recommended only when combined with client-side encryption.
- Secure Zoom share + NDA + ephemeral screen record: for exec summaries only (no raw appendices).

Redaction checklist (what we usually remove from distributed copies):
- Internal contractor PII or third-party contact details
- Exact exploit PoC code snippets (we provide sanitized pseudo-code)
- Customer-specific CVEs that identify third-party integrations

Next steps from our side:
1) I’ll attach the encrypted executive summary now.
2) If you want the full report, please confirm NDA or upload your standard DPA/NDA to the Drive link below and state whether Acme needs contractor redactions.
3) If you choose the tokenized vault option, reply with the preferred recipient emails and any IP range or SSO requirement.

We’ll also include a short remediation status table (open findings and ticket IDs) so your team can track closure.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redaction-checklist.pdf (PDF)
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/XYZ9k-access-request

Cindy
